title: 영화 예매 화면 읽기: 몇 시, 몇 관, 어느 자리?
objective: You can read a Korean movie booking screen and find the time, room, seats left, age rating, and your seats.
summary: Learners read a Korean movie booking screen to find the showtime, room, seats left, age rating, and seats.
note: The cinema name, movie title, and numbers on this screen are made up for practice.

task.title: Read the booking screen
task.line: Look at the screen words on page 1, then answer, choose, or fill in each item.

items.text: It shows when the movie starts and ends.
It shows the room number, like 3관.
It shows how many seats you can still buy.
Choose it for a grown-up ticket.
Choose it for middle and high school students.
The letter is the row and the number is the seat.
You hear the real voices and read Korean text.
Voice actors speak the lines in Korean.
12세 관람가 means age 12 and up. 전체 관람가 means all ages.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Times use the 24-hour clock: 19:00 is 7 p.m. 잔여석 8/120 means 8 seats left out of 120.

exercises: Read this screen line and answer in English: 7관 | 20:40 ~ 22:35 | 잔여석 12/98 — ① When does the movie end? ② How many seats can you still buy? ③ Which screen room is it?
Put the booking steps in order: 결제 / 영화 선택 / 좌석 선택 / 인원 선택
A 13-year-old wants to see a movie alone. Can they? Write Yes or No: ① 전체 관람가 ② 15세 관람가 ③ 12세 관람가
Choose 자막 or 더빙: ① You want to hear the actors' real voices and read Korean text on the screen. ② Your six-year-old child cannot read yet.
Fill in the blank with 성인 or 청소년: ① 저는 서른 살이에요. 표는 ____ 1명이에요. ② 제 동생은 열여섯 살이에요. 표는 ____ 1명이에요.
answers: 영화 선택 → 인원 선택 → 좌석 선택 → 결제
① Yes ② No ③ Yes
